formalReleaseRequires: All inventory groups verified without unresolved parity limits
Population and facility targets met at agreed representative scales
Interactive generation target: 10 seconds per fixed case; worker timeout remains a separate 60-second safety bound

features.evidence: Native, legacy and Freeform formats remain distinct.
Cancellable workers, same-run checkpoints and history-identity guards.
Accepted curves, widths and anchors survive edits and reload.
Physical wall widths, ratio and narrow-corridor rejection.
Shared nodes, dry straight crossings and centralized skew policy.
Holes, disconnected land, frontage and changed district restrictions.
Facility-first packing and conserved population are verified. The fixed 5000-person case leaves 2900 people and all 294 requested facilities unplaced at its bounded placement budget.
Accessible defense sites and legal moats work. Detailed legacy defense plans are preserved in the original document; complete automatic semantic conversion is not established.
Bank references, reservations, activity and locked booths work. Full legacy port navigation, cargo and detailed ship-plan parity is not established.
Accessible reserved sites and optional BV assets work. Full parity with legacy automatic landscape and culture settings is not established.
Authored pads, grading, stairs and source restoration work. Draw-grid terrain is approximate; a continuous vertical-error guarantee across sharp grading breaklines is not established.
Same accepted footprints and stage IDs; translated-frame float32 precision is protected by a local render origin.
Stable logical IDs for 3D selection; metre length and closed area from accepted curves.
Atomic history, cancellation and stale identical-JSON transactions.
Complete documents and input recipes remain separate; original source is retained.
Locked and authored geometry is preserved; display visibility does not release reservations.
